sentences.text: ReefCircular is a cohort company whose country is recorded as DK, and the sources we read hold no register entry for it.
Its record is one of the fuller ones in the cohort: four award records, the latest dated 2026-06-30, and two first customer or pilot records dated 2024-06-14 and 2025-02-04.
It also shows grant or public funding records dated 2025-02-03 and 2025-11-20 and a funding round dated 2024-02-15.
A programme-entry record on the apelago.fi site is dated 2026-02-09 and an exhibitor or demo entry is dated 2026-08-19.
Business and investment readiness are unknown on the radar's rules because the funding is not from a source those rules read.
For the fund this is a watchlist case with more dated activity than most, and the funding and pilot records are worth checking at their sources.
